factor_definitions.momentum: Average percentile of 1M/3M/6M return, RSI(14), price vs 50-day MA and price vs 200-day MA

factor_definitions.value: Average percentile of earnings yield (1/PE), book yield (1/PB) and dividend yield
factor_definitions.attention: Average percentile of 7-day news count, plus Reddit mentions and StockTwits activity (US only)
factor_definitions.reporting: Average percentile of days to next earnings (sooner = higher) and last EPS surprise %
factor_definitions.quality: Equal-weighted average of three groups: profitability (ROE, ROA, operating margin), cash flow (FCF yield, operating cash flow / net income; skipped for banks and insurers) and growth (revenue and earnings growth, year on year)
